html:
SMTO-TSK-0060 — This conversation's files are still needed by unfinished work

GUID: 488bd3fd-d776-44f9-952a-a062c5b8492c
Slug: conversation-evidence-in-use
Domain: TSK · Subsystem: tsk

What happened

  • You asked to delete this conversation's files or all of its data, but a task in it hasn't finished and still needs them. Nothing was deleted.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open the conversation and look for a task that is still running, waiting for your answer or approval, paused, or has messages queued after it. That unfinished task is what still needs the files.
  2. Let that task finish, answer what it is waiting for, or select Stop on it. Delete any queued follow-up you no longer want. Once no work in the conversation needs the files, SMTO allows them to be deleted.
  3. Choose Delete artifacts or Delete everything from the conversation's Retention menu again. With the work settled, it is now safe to repeat the deletion.

What success looks like

  • The deletion finishes and SMTO shows "Retention action completed."

If it still fails

  • If every task looks finished but deletion is still refused, a step may have an unconfirmed result. Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete SMTO's data folder by hand to force it.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • An artifacts or everything purge found a run in this conversation that is not settled (running, waiting, paused, pending operations, unknown outcomes, cleanup pending or queued follow-ups) and still requires its retained evidence and artifacts.

What this means

  • Artifact/everything purge finds evidence still required by active or resumable owned work, including its retained artifact references. Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.

Why this can happen

  • Artifact/everything purge finds evidence still required by active or resumable owned work, including its retained artifact references.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the owning work and exact required artifact/history references before retention changes.

How to fix it

  • Find the unsettled run for this conversation (status running, waiting_*, paused or awaiting_confirmation, pending operations, unknown_operations, stop cleanup pending, or queued follow-ups) and let it finish or stop it and resolve unknown outcomes. Then request the artifacts or everything purge again; do not loop the request while the run is unsettled.
  • Let the owning work finish or use its supported abandon controls before removing retained evidence.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Required work settles or supported explicit abandonment makes the requested purge eligible.

What not to do

  • Do not use a rapid retry loop or replay an uncertain mutation while waiting for the stated condition.

Technical notes

  • Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
